title: Retrieve additional information for a user's business details

businessId.description: A unique identifier for the business income source. Previously known as selfEmploymentId.

typeOfBusiness.description: The type of business income source.

tradingType.description: The type of trading carried out by the business.

tradingName.description: The trading name of the business.

firstAccountingPeriodStartDate.description: The first accounting period start date. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD` Note: Accounting period start and end dates should not be displayed to users of your software.

firstAccountingPeriodEndDate.description: The first accounting period end date. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD` Note: Accounting period start and end dates should not be displayed to users of your software.

latencyEndDate.description: End date of latency period for the income source. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

taxYear1.description: First tax year for the income source.

taxYear2.description: Second tax year for the income source.

quarterlyPeriodType.description: The quarterly period type that is being chosen for the business ID. For standard quarters, `quarterlyTypeChoice` is only returned when the customer has previously selected calendar quarters, and then switched back to standard.

taxYearOfChoice.description: The tax year for which the quarterly period type was chosen.

accountingPeriods.description: The start and end dates of the latest accounting period for the business. This array contains dates for the latest accounting period only. Note: Accounting period start and end dates should not be displayed to users of your software.

start.description: Date your books or accounts start - the beginning of your accounting period. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

end.description: Date your books or accounts are made up to - the end of your accounting period. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

commencementDate.description: Business start date, must be in the past. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

cessationDate.description: Business cessation date. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

businessAddressLineOne.description: First line of the business address.

businessAddressLineTwo.description: Second line of the business address.

businessAddressLineThree.description: Third line of the business address.

businessAddressLineFour.description: Fourth line of the business address.

businessAddressCountryCode.description: ISO country code for the business if it is in a non-GB country. The two-letter code for a country must adhere to ISO 3166.
